data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'heah' meaning 'high' and 'dun' meaning 'hill' or 'fort'. The name Henderson is of Anglo-Saxon origin and translates to 'strong, hard ruler'. The name has historical significance as a surname for Scottish clans and a given name in the English-speaking world.

In Scotland, the name is often spelled as 'Henderson' or 'McHenderson', while in Ireland it is more commonly spelled as 'Henderson' or 'O'Henderson'. Today, the name is found in many parts of the world, particularly in countries with a significant Scottish or Irish diaspora. The name has also gained popularity as a given name in some English-speaking countries.
